title: Auxiliary standardized eighth-power problem and local essentially smooth factorization
statement: Let k be a field of characteristic p>0, A a finitely presented k-algebra, Lambda a Noetherian geometrically regular k-algebra [def-weil-pbc-g-ring], alpha:A \to Lambda a k-algebra map and q a prime minimal over popescuIdeal(alpha) [def-weil-pbc-popescu-resolution]. There exist a polynomial k-algebra R=k[y_1,...,y_m] [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring], compatible R-algebra structures on Lambda and a finitely presented R-algebra C, a k-algebra map beta:A \to C and an R-algebra map gamma:C \to Lambda, with gamma beta=alpha and popescuIdeal(alpha) contained in popescuIdeal(gamma). There is a nonempty finite family pi_i in R whose images lie in q, whose multiplications and squared multiplications have equal kernels on each successive quotient by the preceding eighth powers, both for R and Lambda. Each image of pi_i in C is strictly standard [def-weil-pbc-strictly-standard-element]. Put J=(pi_i^8), R_0=R/J, C_0=C/JC and Lambda_0=Lambda/JLambda. There are a finite-presentation witness for C_0 over R_0, the induced map gamma_0 and quotient prime q_0, commuting with the quotient maps and lying over q. Either popescuIdeal(gamma_0) is not contained in q_0, or q_0 is minimal over it, dim((Lambda_0)_(q_0))=0, and the canonical map (R_0)_(q_0 \cap R_0) \otimes_(R_0) C_0 \to (Lambda_0)_(q_0) factors through an essentially smooth algebra E over (R_0)_(q_0 \cap R_0) [def-weil-pbc-essentially-smooth-ring-map; def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]. The carriers C and E may be represented in the universe max(u,v), where k:Type u and A:Type v.

proof.text: Apply the strengthened core construction to p,hp,α,q,hreg,hminimal. Unpack its polynomial algebra structures, C, β, γ, parameters, annihilator and strict-standard conditions, positive power bound and auxiliary thickening factorization.

Apply the quotient descent theorem with those structures and auxiliary witnesses. Reassemble the unchanged target conjunction and existential witnesses, including the quotient maps, prime, alternatives and final essentially smooth factorization.

theorem exists_popescu_char_p_preparation
    {k : Type u} {A : Type v} {Λ : Type w}
    [Field k] [CommRing A] [CommRing Λ] [Algebra k A] [Algebra k Λ]
    [FinitePresentation k A] [IsNoetherianRing Λ]
    (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] (hp : 0 < p)
    (α : A →ₐ[k] Λ) (q : PrimeSpectrum Λ)
    (hreg : IsGeometricallyRegular k Λ)
    (hminimal : q.asIdeal ∈ (popescuIdeal α).minimalPrimes) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (_ : Algebra (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) Λ)
      (_ : IsScalarTower k (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) Λ)
      (C : Type (max u v)) (_ : CommRing C) (_ : Algebra k C)
      (_ : Algebra (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) C)
      (_ : IsScalarTower k (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) C)
      (_ : FinitePresentation (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) C)
      (β : A →ₐ[k] C) (γ : C →ₐ[MvPolynomial (Fin m) k] Λ),
      (γ.restrictScalars k).comp β = α ∧ popescuIdeal α ≤ popescuIdeal γ ∧
      ∃ (r : ℕ) (π : Fin r → MvPolynomial (Fin m) k),
        1 ≤ r ∧
        (∀ i, algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) Λ (π i) ∈ q.asIdeal) ∧
        (∀ (i : Fin r)
          (x : MvPolynomial (Fin m) k ⧸ Ideal.span
            {y | ∃ j : Fin r, j.val < i.val ∧ y = π j ^ 8}),
          π i • x = 0 ↔ π i ^ 2 • x = 0) ∧
        (∀ (i : Fin r)
          (x : Λ ⧸ Ideal.span
            {y | ∃ j : Fin r, j.val < i.val ∧
              y = algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) Λ (π j) ^ 8}),
          π i • x = 0 ↔ π i ^ 2 • x = 0) ∧
        (∀ i, IsStrictlyStandardElement
          (R := MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) C (π i))) ∧
        let R := MvPolynomial (Fin m) k
        let J := Ideal.span (Set.range (fun i : Fin r ↦ π i ^ 8))
        let J_C := J.map (algebraMap R C)
        let J_Λ := J.map (algebraMap R Λ)
        let R₀ := R ⧸ J
        let C₀ := C ⧸ J_C
        let Λ₀ := Λ ⧸ J_Λ
        ∃ (_ : FinitePresentation R₀ C₀) (γ₀ : C₀ →ₐ[R₀] Λ₀)
          (q₀ : PrimeSpectrum Λ₀),
          γ₀.toRingHom.comp (Ideal.Quotient.mk J_C) =
            (Ideal.Quotient.mk J_Λ).comp γ.toRingHom ∧
          PrimeSpectrum.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk J_Λ) q₀ = q ∧
          (¬ popescuIdeal γ₀ ≤ q₀.asIdeal ∨
            q₀.asIdeal ∈ (popescuIdeal γ₀).minimalPrimes ∧
            ringKrullDim (Localization.AtPrime q₀.asIdeal) = 0 ∧
            let P := Localization.AtPrime (q₀.asIdeal.under R₀)
            let L := Localization.AtPrime q₀.asIdeal
            letI := Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver
              (q₀.asIdeal.under R₀) q₀.asIdeal
            ∃ (E : Type (max u v)) (_ : CommRing E) (_ : Algebra P E),
              EssentiallySmooth P E ∧
              ∃ (f : P ⊗[R₀] C₀ →ₐ[P] E) (g : E →ₐ[P] L),
                g.comp f = Algebra.TensorProduct.lift (Algebra.ofId P L)
                  ((IsScalarTower.toAlgHom R₀ Λ₀ L).comp γ₀)
                  (fun _ _ ↦ Commute.all _ _))
